words: widen cl-6.decisions' endorsement for account F to routine decisions that narrow or keep access (session resets, repository detaches, tightenings) and to cl-6.abp's proposed relaxations, each with cl-6.security's review, one-way doors excepted
decision: cl-6.decisions (account F) may also decide, for account F only: (1) routine decisions that narrow or keep access, such as session resets, repository detaches and tightenings; (2) relaxations proposed by cl-6.abp. Each needs cl-6.security's review first. One-way doors stay with Dinis.

how.review: cl-6.security reviews each one before cl-6.decisions signs; no review, no record. A relaxation the review does not pass goes to Dinis.
how.kept for Dinis: main, money, legal commitments, one-way doors, keys or vault keys, AWS, GitHub App privileges, connectors, private people's details, the rules, and anything touching another account. A relaxation counts only when cl-6.abp proposed it; one that widens access beyond account F, or that cl-6.security calls a one-way door, goes to Dinis.
how.relay: Every record is relayed to decisions.b by link, as before; decisions.b may object, which suspends it until Dinis rules.
how.endorsement: keys/endorsements/decisions-f.json is reissued with this scope; the expiry stays 2026-11-30, with decisions.b's own link.
